approach: Add one fixed paragraph under the verifier brief's "Checks Athena ran on this tree" heading in briefs.rs saying the listed fmt/clippy/test results are recorded for this candidate, are not to be rerun, and that the full `cargo test` suite is never rerun (only targeted `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`). A failed or missing check stays failed or unverified. Mirror this in both verifier prompts, add a reader.md rule that full-suite, fmt and clippy outcomes are content criteria satisfied by the recorded checks, and record the change in CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md. Prompt and brief text only; no allow-list, timeout or check-running change.

decisions.choice: Put the instruction in the brief body under the checks heading, as static text, and also in both verifier prompts.
decisions.reason: The brief is what the verifier reads next to the results, and the prompt is the standing rule. Both are needed for criterion 1 and 2. A test can assert the brief text.

rejected.why: Not adjacent to the results and not testable from the rendered brief.
No caller exists, it only yields text on a SHA match, and it adds code and risk for no extra effect; the checks list is already for the candidate.

decisions.choice: Keep `cargo test` in the verifier allow-list; forbid only the full-suite rerun by instruction.
decisions.reason: Targeted tests are needed to exercise new behavior.

rejected.option: Remove cargo test from the allow-list
rejected.why: Prevents targeted tests; out of scope.

decisions.choice: Brief text states a failed check stays failed; a missing check is not treated as passed (verifier should report it, not rerun the full suite).
decisions.reason: Criterion 3: nothing may turn a failed or missing result into a pass.

rejected.why: The checks list can contain failures; the text must not override it.

decisions.choice: verify.rs gets only a doc-comment note that reuse_statement is not part of the brief path and reuse is limited to the same SHA; no logic change.
decisions.reason: Listed deliverable, keeps the same-SHA limit explicit without behavior change. Skip if it adds nothing.

files.purpose: Emit the no-rerun paragraph under the checks heading in the verifier brief; add test; update stored brief snapshot constant(s).
Tell verifiers to cite recorded checks and run only targeted tests.
Align the change capability's verifier line with recorded-check reuse.
Tell readers not to write behavior criteria needing full-suite, fmt or clippy reruns.
Record the change and the 2026-10-18 timeouts as the reason.
Record the decision and rejected options.
Doc-comment note only on same-SHA reuse; no logic change.

steps: Grep for 'Checks Athena ran' across the repo to find every stored copy and test.
Edit briefs.rs: add the paragraph after the heading writeln; update VERIFIER_BRIEF_WITHOUT_A_PLAN and any other snapshot; add the placement test (with one failed check).
Edit both verifier.md prompts and reader.md.
Add the doc-comment note in verify.rs.
Add CHANGELOG.md entry naming the 2026-10-18 timeouts and the docs/decisions.md entry.
Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo test -p athena-context.

risks.risk: Instruction read as permission to skip judging failed checks.
risks.mitigation: State explicitly in the brief and prompt that a failed check is a failed check and a missing one is reported, not assumed passed; the new test asserts the failed line is unchanged.
Run cargo test -p athena-context and grep all crates for the heading text before finishing.

risks.risk: Verifier stops running targeted tests too.
risks.mitigation: Keep each addition to a few sentences; do not touch the allow-list.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff of the checks-section writer in briefs.rs.
demonstrations.observes: Text under '## Checks Athena ran on this tree' says the fmt, clippy and test results are recorded for this candidate, must not be rerun, and the full `cargo test` suite is not rerun.

The verifier prompt says to cite the recorded check for a 'cargo test passes' criterion and to run only targeted tests such as `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`; the change prompt's 'ran the tests' line does not conflict.

demonstrations.method: Read the reader prompt diff and the brief text.
demonstrations.observes: Readers are told full suite, fmt and clippy outcomes are content criteria satisfied by recorded checks; the wording states a failed or missing recorded check is not a pass, and no code path changes check pass/fail.

demonstrations.method: New test in briefs.rs renders a verifier brief with a failing and a passing check and asserts the no-rerun sentence appears after the checks heading and before the first check line (and before '## Commands Bash may run'), and that the failed line still reads 'failed'.
demonstrations.observes: Test passes; reverting the brief text makes the assertion fail.
demonstrations.fails_without: The assertion that the no-rerun instruction sits between the checks heading and the check list fails if the sentence is absent or misplaced.

demonstrations.method: Run the crate tests, then `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check`.
demonstrations.observes: All pass; VERIFIER_BRIEF_WITHOUT_A_PLAN (and any other stored brief copy) was updated deliberately to include the new paragraph; clippy and fmt are clean.
demonstrations.fails_without: The byte-identical snapshot test a_verifier_brief_without_a_plan_is_byte_identical_to_the_stored_copy fails if the constant is not updated.

demonstrations.method: Inspect the diff stat and the CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md hunks.
demonstrations.observes: Only the listed deliverables changed; CHANGELOG.md entry names the 2026-10-18 verifier timeouts (full suite about 11 minutes) as the reason; no secrets or personal data.

open_questions: Other stored brief copies or snapshot tests (beyond VERIFIER_BRIEF_WITHOUT_A_PLAN) that include the checks section may exist in briefs.rs or other crates; the producer should grep for 'Checks Athena ran' after the edit.
Whether the study capability shares crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md (out of scope for its own verifier prompt); the producer should check that the shared prompt edit is acceptable there.
